entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The applicant has filed this second bail application u/S.483 of BNSS for grant of bail.

Applicant has been arrested on 13.11.2025 by Police Station- Joura, District- Morena, in connection with Crime No.437/2009 for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 and 120B of IPC.
First application was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 08.01.2026 passed in MCRC No.59203/2025 by this Court.
The allegation against the present applicant is that he along with his wife/co-accused committed fraud with the customers of the Post Office by illegally withdrawing the deposited money.
Accordingly, offence was registered.
It is the submission of learned counsel for the applicant that false case has been registered against the applicant and he is in confinement since 13.11.2025.
Applicant has not committed any offence.

It is further submitted NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-GWL:4603 2 MCRC-5496-2026 that applicant has deposited the complete consideration of money before the Trial Court as alleged to have been embezzled (receipts of which have been produced before this Court).
Investigation is almost complete and charge sheet is likely to be filed soon.
Applicant does not bear any criminal record.
Applicant undertakes to cooperate in trial as well as investigation and would make herself available as and when required.
The co-accused namely Radha Mangal has already been enlarged on bail by this Court vide order dated 30.01.2026 passed in M.Cr.C. No.1088/2026, therefore applicant seeks parity also.
He would abide by the terms and conditions as imposed by this Court.
Under these grounds, counsel prayed for bail.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the respondent/State opposed the prayer and prayed for dismissal of this application.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.

Considering the submissions advanced by learned counsel for the parties and having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case, as well as the fact that the applicant has deposited the whole amount of embezzled money,
before the Trial Court but, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

It is hereby directed that subject to depositing the remaining amount, the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court.

The applicant will not indulge himself in extending inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to the Police Officer, as the case may be;
Application stands allowed and disposed of.
Copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance.
Certified copy as per rules.
